sentences.zh: 阿拉伯语中的 mukawama 意思是抵抗。

sentences.en: Iran and its proxies, Hezbollah and the Houthis and Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad and the militias in Iraq and in Syria,
sentences.zh: 伊朗及其代理人，即真主党、胡塞武装、哈马斯、巴勒斯坦伊斯兰圣战组织以及伊拉克和叙利亚的民兵，

sentences.en: they call themselves Jawa al-Mukawama, the axis of resistance.
sentences.zh: 他们自称为抵抗之弧（Axis of Resistance）。

sentences.en: And this case is a test of how much Iran is willing to risk in order to save the other partner of this axis.
sentences.zh: 而这一次是对伊朗愿意冒多大风险来拯救该轴心另一个伙伴的一次考验。

sentences.en: This is the core of their partnership, the core of their brotherhood.
sentences.zh: 这是他们伙伴关系的核心，是他们兄弟情谊的核心。

sentences.en: And so Israel wants to break the alignment.
sentences.zh: 因此，以色列想要打破这种结盟。

sentences.en: Israel wants to destroy the axis.
sentences.zh: 以色列想要摧毁这个轴心。

sentences.en: And I think that the next few days or weeks are going to be quite significant in the history of the war, the regional war between Israel and the axis of resistance.
sentences.zh: 我认为未来几天或几周在以色列与抵抗之弧的地区战争史上将具有相当重要的意义。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm going to go out on a limb here and say this all sounds like a very difficult situation to resolve.
sentences.zh: 我要冒昧地说一句，这一切听起来都是一个非常难以解决的局面。

sentences.en: Mark, I want to turn back to you and ask, given this history, what would a path to a resolution even look like here?
sentences.zh: 马克，我想把话题转回给你，请问鉴于这段历史，这里的解决之路到底会是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, there's no easy path.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有什么轻松的道路。

sentences.en: And you could see at the end of last week, everyone sort of groping around trying to figure out how to sort of handle all of these thorny issues at once.
sentences.zh: 你可以从上周末结束时看到，每个人都在摸索着，试图弄清楚如何同时处理所有这些棘手的问题。

sentences.en: There was an announcement that Prime Minister Netanyahu and the Israeli government would begin discussions with the Lebanese government about the future of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 有消息称，内塔尼亚胡总理和以色列政府将开始与黎巴嫩政府就冲突的未来展开讨论。

sentences.en: But of course, the Lebanese government is not speaking for Hezbollah and no one's dealing and negotiating directly with Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 但当然，黎巴嫩政府并不代表真主党发言，也没有人与真主党直接打交道和谈判。

sentences.en: So that appeared to be a little bit of a fig leaf to sort of appear something was happening where no one really expects much out of that.
sentences.zh: 所以这似乎有点像一块遮羞布，让人觉得有什么事情正在发生，尽管没有人真正指望能从中得出什么大结果。

sentences.en: And given that all of these issues are so closely stitched together, it does seem like this is all very intractable at the moment.
sentences.zh: 鉴于所有这些问题都如此紧密地交织在一起，目前看来这一切确实非常棘手。

sentences.en: When we've talked in the past, guys, you've both said that while a lot of people view Netanyahu as having a certain amount of sway over Trump,
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我们过去交谈时，你们都曾说过，虽然很多人认为内塔尼亚胡对特朗普有一定的影响力，

sentences.en: you've made it clear that Netanyahu does fear Trump.
sentences.zh: 但你们也明确指出，内塔尼亚胡确实害怕特朗普。

sentences.en: He does acquiesce to his demands.
sentences.zh: 他确实对特朗普的要求言听计从。

sentences.en: So can't Trump force Israel to stop carrying out strikes that are threatening this truce?
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普难道不能强迫以色列停止进行那些威胁到这场休战的袭击吗？

sentences.en: I guess my question is, who is actually in charge here?
sentences.zh: 我想我的问题是，这里到底谁在做主？

sentences.en: No doubt Prime Minister Netanyahu acknowledged that in a speech, I think three weeks after the beginning of the war, while at the beginning he said, we are partners,
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，内塔尼亚胡总理曾在一次讲话中承认过这一点——我想是在战争开始三周后，虽然一开始他说过我们是伙伴，

sentences.en: mutual partners.
sentences.zh: 相互的伙伴。

sentences.en: Then he said, under the leadership of President Trump, he said something that was clear to any soldier, any officer, any general in the IDF,
sentences.zh: 然后他说，在特朗普总统的领导下——他说了一些让以色列国防军的任何士兵、任何军官、任何将军都听得明白的话：

sentences.en: that this war will end only when Trump says it's over.
sentences.zh: 这场战争只有在特朗普说结束时才会结束。

sentences.en: So it's clear that if President Trump decides that something would happen and be very strict with that, the Prime Minister Netanyahu would not go to overt confrontation with him.
sentences.zh: 所以很显然，如果特朗普总统决定发生某事并对此严加管束，内塔尼亚胡总理是不会与他公开对抗的。

sentences.en: No, that's one of the things that he's very strict with, he won't.
sentences.zh: 不，这是他管得非常严的事情之一，他不会（对抗）。

sentences.en: So should we assume, based on that, that Trump has not actually pulled that ultimate lever yet?
sentences.zh: 那么我们是否应该据此假设，特朗普实际上还没有动用那张终极王牌？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's not clear to Trump yet that Hezbollah and Lebanon are the number one sticking point preventing a deal with Iran.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为特朗普目前还不清楚真主党和黎巴嫩是阻碍与伊朗达成协议的头号症结所在。

sentences.en: But the more Hezbollah and Lebanon become central to whether this war ends or not, the more I think the United States and Trump will lean on Netanyahu to end the campaign.
sentences.zh: 但真主党和黎巴嫩对这场战争是否结束变得越重要，我认为美国和特朗普就会越加施压内塔尼亚胡以结束这场军事行动。

sentences.en: I want to just end by taking us back to the beginning of this war, when Trump decided to do something that no American president had ever agreed to before,
sentences.zh: 我想以将我们带回这场战争之初作为结束——当时特朗普决定做一件此前没有任何美国总统敢答应的事，

sentences.en: which was teaming up with Israel to go to war with Iran.
sentences.zh: 那就是与以色列联手对伊朗发动战争。

sentences.en: We're now in a situation where it's unclear whether the two countries that got into this war together are actually on the same page about getting out of it.
sentences.zh: 我们现在处于这样一种境地：这场共同引发战争的两个国家是否对如何退出战争意见一致，目前尚不得而知。

sentences.en: And I just want to ask, like, is this just the inevitable result of getting into a joint war with a partner that doesn't share your long-term goals?
sentences.zh: 我只想问，这难道不是与一个不共享你长期目标的伙伴卷入一场联合战争的必然结果吗？

sentences.en: I think that's partly right.
sentences.zh: 我认为这在一定程度上是正确的。

sentences.en: And I think there's also a sense for Netanyahu that he's not going to get another chance to do this.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为内塔尼亚胡也有一种感觉，那就是他不会再有第二次机会来做这件事了。

sentences.en: A war against Iran has been Netanyahu's obsession for decades.
sentences.zh: 对伊朗的战争几十年来一直是内塔尼亚胡的执念。

sentences.en: And now he's got the United States president leading the war.
sentences.zh: 而现在他让美国总统带头发动了这场战争。

sentences.en: And once that ends, it's probably not happening again.
sentences.zh: 一旦这一切结束，可能就不会再发生了。

sentences.en: And so he sees this as his last best chance to achieve these goals in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，他将这视为他实现中东这些目标的最后且最佳的机会。

sentences.en: And he's going to be determined that nothing ends before he gets most of what he wanted.
sentences.zh: 他将下定决心，在得到他大部分想要的东西之前，绝不让任何事情结束。

sentences.en: Which is why Netanyahu and his team and ministers, when hearing the announcement from Islamabad, that negotiation fell apart, they said,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么内塔尼亚胡及其团队和部长们在听到伊斯兰堡宣布谈判破裂时，他们说，

sentences.en: ha, you see, this is President Trump that we like, that is not giving up, that is going full force, and they are hoping we'll go back to Warsaw.
sentences.zh: 哈，你看，这就是我们喜欢的特朗普总统，他没有放弃，正在全力以赴，他们希望我们能回到华沙。

sentences.en: And so, this thing keeps going on.
sentences.zh: 所以，这件事一直在继续。

sentences.en: Well, Mark, Ronan, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，马克，罗南，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks, Ali.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，阿里。

sentences.en: Thanks, Heather.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，希瑟。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周日，美国

sentences.en: military said that it would blockade any ships entering and departing Iranian ports beginning Monday, but would allow other ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 军方表示，将从周一开始封锁所有进出伊朗港口的船只，但将允许其他船只通过霍尔木兹海峡。

sentences.en: The move was a step back from Trump's earlier promise to block all traffic through the Strait.
sentences.zh: 此举比特朗普先前承诺封锁海峡所有交通的言论有所退让。

sentences.en: In response, the Speaker of Iran's parliament directly addressed American consumers, saying, quote, soon you'll be nostalgic for $4 to $5 gas.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，伊朗议会议长直接向美国消费者喊话，他说，引述，很快你们就会怀念4到5美元的油价了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Eric Swalwell, a Democratic congressman from the Bay Area, said on Sunday that he was suspending his campaign for California governor
sentences.zh: 来自湾区的民主党众议员埃里克·斯瓦尔韦尔于周日宣布暂停其加州州长竞选，

sentences.en: in the wake of allegations of sexual assault and misconduct.
sentences.zh: 此前他遭到了性侵犯和不当行为的指控。

sentences.en: The accusations were published Friday in articles by the San Francisco Chronicle and CNN, and they prompted a wave of rescinded endorsements and a criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 这些指控于周五发表在《旧金山纪事报》和CNN的文章中，并引发了一波撤回支持潮以及刑事调查。

sentences.en: Swalwell repeatedly denied the accusations and said in an ex-post on Saturday that he was sorry for, quote,
sentences.zh: 斯瓦尔韦尔一再否认这些指控，并在周六的一条前推特帖子中表示，他为，引述，

sentences.en: mistakes in judgment and promised to fight what he called false allegations.
sentences.zh: 判断失误感到抱歉，并承诺反击他所说的虚假指控。

sentences.en: And Viktor Orban, the right-wing populist who's been prime minister of Hungary for 16 years, conceded that he lost the country's general election on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 而担任匈牙利总理长达16年的右翼民粹主义者维克托·欧尔班承认，他在周日的国家大选中落败。

sentences.en: Orban was such a staunch ally of President Trump's that Vice President J.D.
sentences.zh: 欧尔班是特朗普总统的坚定盟友，以至于副总统万斯

sentences.en: Vance flew to Budapest last week to rally with him.
sentences.zh: 上周飞往布达佩斯与他一同集会。

sentences.en: But Vance's appearance didn't help Orban avert a landslide defeat to the center-right opposition, which is led by a former Orban loyalist, Peter Magyar.
sentences.zh: 但万斯的露面并未能帮助欧尔班避免惨败给由欧尔班前忠信者彼得·马扎尔领导的中右翼反对派。

sentences.en: Magyar campaigned on an anti-corruption message and promised to improve relations with the European Union, which had been strained over Orban's pro-Russia stance.
sentences.zh: 马扎尔以反腐败为竞选口号，并承诺改善与欧盟的关系，此前欧盟因欧尔班的亲俄立场而关系紧张。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为假期招待客人的活动做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的技巧。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要完全黑暗才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片才能睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
